text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega takes the lead! Admire Vega 
takes the lead! The brilliance of the 
first-magnitude star races across Fuchu!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, Ayabe-san, Ayabe-san— Stay 
right there...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Thwarting the Overlord's triumphant 
return! Holding off the furious late 
charge! Here comes Admire Vega, it's 
Admire Vega!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
“—Crosses the finish line!! Shining bright 
as the glorious first star is Admire Vega! 
It's Admire Vega!!”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Thank goodness... Ayabe-san didn't lose 
to anyone."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Because—I am the one who wants to win.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
For Ayabe-san... not Opera O-chan, not 
Doto-chan, but ME!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Narita Top Road is determined to win...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh... Uwaaaaaaaaah~~~~!! I couldn't 
reach it... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. You chased, and I took the lead. 
Even so, she was the one who took the 
prize.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"All that remains is to applaud. Our very 
own first-magnitude star—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Nay, to the "Fin-de-Siècle Raging 
First-Magnitude Star"!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, you really were standing right 
there the whole time, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Along the path I tread. Where you see me 
off to the start, and welcome me back past 
the goal.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even when pushed away or full of doubt, in 
the end, always just tagging along 
regardless—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list:
I'll still be here for you from now on, 
too.
